clock_source.note: This schedule has a machine-verified anchor for the first time. Until today the preflight parsed only 'HH:MMZ' in slate column 3, so the full ISO timestamps the 8/27 and 8/28 slates carry were silently dropped and first pitch read UNKNOWN — the T-90 and T-45 offsets had nothing to measure against. Fixed and covered by selftest.
